note: A curse cast on a target and the enemies around it: their fire resistance falls (25% to 44%). Used by the AI on packs and rare enemies, one curse at a time.

def.name: Tinder Curse
def.description: Curses enemies in an area: they lose fire resistance.

note: A curse that lowers the cold resistance of the enemies it falls on (25% to 44%).

def.name: Rime Curse
def.description: Curses enemies in an area: they lose cold resistance.

note: A curse that lowers the lightning resistance of the enemies it falls on (25% to 44%).

def.name: Static Curse
def.description: Curses enemies in an area: they lose lightning resistance.

note: A curse cast on a target and the enemies around it: their chaos resistance falls by 20% to 29%, they take 15% to 25% more damage over time, and hits against them add chaos damage.

def.name: Void Curse
def.description: Curses enemies in an area: they lose chaos resistance and suffer more from damage over time, and your hits add chaos damage to them.

note: A curse cast on a target and the enemies around it: they have 20% less physical damage reduction, and a melee hit against one makes you a Punisher (30% more melee physical damage, 15% more attack speed) for nine seconds.

def.name: Penance
def.description: Curses enemies in an area: they lose physical damage reduction, and hitting them in melee makes you hit harder and faster.

note: A curse that lowers chaos resistance and makes enemies take more damage (the curses it spreads on death are dropped).

def.name: Ruin Ritual
def.description: A ritual that rots a small area: enemies lose chaos resistance and take more damage.

note: A mark: hits against the marked enemy have a higher critical strike chance and multiplier; killing it restores 16 to 25 life and mana and has a 21% to 30% chance to give an Insight charge.

def.name: Ruin Sigil
def.description: Marks an enemy: you crit it more often and harder, and killing it restores life and mana and may give an Insight charge.

note: A mark: the marked enemy has 30% to 49% less evasion; attack hits against it give life and mana back; killing it doubles the flask charges gained and has a 21% to 30% chance to give a Fervour charge.

def.name: Plenty Sigil
def.description: Marks an enemy: it has less evasion, hitting it with attacks restores life and mana, and killing it fills your flasks and may give a Fervour charge.

note: A mark: the character deals more projectile damage with more accuracy to the marked, which also take more damage.

def.name: Hunt Sigil
def.description: Marks an enemy: your projectiles hit it harder and truer.

note: A mark: the marked enemy is 10% likelier to be stunned and stays stunned longer; your attack hits leech 2% of their damage as life and as mana; killing it has a 21% to 30% chance to give a Grit charge.

def.name: Warlord Sigil
def.description: Marks an enemy: it is easier to stun, your attacks leech life and mana from it, and killing it may give a Grit charge.

note: A warcry cast when a pack or a rare enemy is near: it regenerates life and grants Grit charges (the scaling with nearby enemies is averaged).

def.name: Steadfast Bellow
def.description: A bellow that steadies you: life regeneration, and a Grit charge.

note: A warcry cast when a pack or a rare enemy is near: more damage and mana regeneration for a few seconds (the allies' share is folded into the character's).

def.name: Rallying Roar
def.description: A roar that rallies you: more damage and mana regeneration.

note: A warcry cast when a pack or a rare enemy is near: it hinders the enemies around the character, more with each other enemy nearby, and makes them burst for a share of their own life if they die while it lasts. Warcries wait four seconds on one another.

def.name: Graveyard Bellow
def.description: A bellow that slows the enemies around you, more of them the more there are, and makes those that die while it lasts burst.

note: A banner you carry (it holds a tenth of your mana) and put down: while it is up its aura raises the accuracy of you and your allies near it and makes the enemies near it take more physical damage. Each kill while you carry it gives a stage; when it is put down each stage widens it, strengthens it and lengthens it, and gives you a moment of Adrenaline. One banner at a time.

def.name: Standard of Valour
def.description: Carry a banner that gives stages for each kill, then put it down: it stands for a while and the enemies near it take more physical damage.

note: A banner you carry (it holds a tenth of your mana) and put down: while it is up its aura gives you and your allies near it a chance to impale and makes the enemies near it less accurate. Each impale while you carry it gives a stage (five a second at most); when it is put down each stage widens it, strengthens it and lengthens it, and gives you a moment of Fortify. One banner at a time.

def.name: Standard of Dread
def.description: Carry a banner that gives stages for each impale, then put it down: it stands for a while and the enemies near it hit less often.
